Saudi civil defence issues all clear for Riyadh minutes after danger alert
item.description:
Saudi civil defence issues all clear for Riyadh minutes after danger alert

Saudi Civil Defence authorities issue all clear for Riyadh City, minutes after warning residents of a “potential danger” and urging them to proceed to the nearest safe place in the capital.

Earlier, similar all clear messages were issued by the General Directorate of Saudi Civil Defense for the city of Dammam and the provinces of al-Ahsa and Abqaiq, minutes are warning residents of potential danger.

item.title: Iran executes three men convicted over January 2026 protests
item.description:
Iran executes three men convicted over January 2026 protests

Iran on Sunday executed three men convicted of taking part in armed unrest during protests in January 2026 and carrying out operations for Israel and the United States, state media reported.

On Saturday, citing judiciary's Mizan Online website, AFP reported the execution of an Iranian,  Mohammad Aref Shahbakhsh, an "operative linked to the terrorist group Jaish al-Zolm (al-Adl)".

Jaish al-Adl is an outlawed militant group in Sistan-Baluchistan province, which has long seen clashes between security forces and armed groups, including Sunni militants and members of the ethnic Baloch minority.

Iran accuses arch-enemies the United States and Israel of supporting armed groups there.

Iran tells Russia talks with US without guarantees won't end conflict, report says
item.description:
Iran tells Russia talks with US without guarantees won't end conflict, report says

Iran’s ambassador to Moscow Kazem Jalali has said Iran and Russia have discussed strengthening military and security cooperation, with Tehran stressing that talks with the US could not end the conflict without credible guarantees, according to Mehr News Agency.

Jalali said that during a three-hour meeting, Major General Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, briefed Russian President Vladimir Putin on Tehran’s strategic priorities, including accelerating construction of the Rasht-Astara railway and completing the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC).

Jalali said Rezaei conveyed Tehran’s position that negotiations with Washington could not end the conflict without credible guarantees, citing repeated "US violations of commitments" during previous diplomatic engagements, Mehr reported.

He said Rezaei also explained Iran’s response to a letter from US Vice President JD Vance, stressing that dialogue alone could not provide a basis for ending the war.

According to Jalali, Rezaei cited several instances in which Iran had come under attack during diplomatic initiatives, including negotiations in Oman and Geneva, as well as engagements surrounding the Islamabad MoU.

The ambassador said Tehran had made acceptance of its seven strategic conditions by Washington a prerequisite for any new diplomatic initiative. He added that Moscow understood Iran’s position and agreed that commitments had to be implemented.

item.title: The writing on the wall: Why Apartheid Israel is on the threshold of defeat
item.description: They were both born in 1948 from the womb of European colonialism. While the immediate catalyst for this dramatic turn of events has been the genocide in Gaza, a key turning point in this process was set in motion in July 2005 when the Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions (BDS) movement was launched. item.title: US offers up to $20M reward for information on Iran’s nuclear program: CENTCOM
item.description: The US military’s Central Command (CENTCOM) said on Friday that the Rewards for Justice program is offering up to $20 million for information about Iran’s nuclear program, Anadolu reports. “Rewards for Justice is offering a reward of up to $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program,” CENTCOM said in a post on US social media platform X. It said the information could cover facilities, equipment and associated personnel, including those in the scientific community, as well as their movements. CENTCOM also shared a link on the Rewards for Justice website where people can submit tips. READ: Australian Prime Minister urges US to de-escalate Iran war after Republican midterm losses

item.title: 2 Palestinians wounded as rain causes collapse of wall in Israeli-damaged building in Gaza
item.description: Two Palestinians were injured in northern Gaza on Saturday after rain caused a wall in a building damaged by earlier Israeli shelling to collapse, a medical source told Anadolu, Anadolu reports. Eyewitnesses said heavy rain flooded thousands of displacement tents near Gaza City’s port, west of Deir al-Balah, north of the Nuseirat refugee camp, and in Jabalia and Beit Lahia. The developments came as a low-pressure system accompanied by a cold air mass and heavy rainfall affected the Gaza Strip, compounding the hardship of thousands of displaced Palestinians sheltering in worn-out tents without heating or adequate protection from rain and cold, amid widespread destruction of homes and infrastructure caused by Israel’s genocidal war.
